title: streptanthus glandulosus subsp. niger
intro: Streptanthus glandulosus subsp. niger, commonly known as Black Stemless Gentian, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help in reducing the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Black Stemless Gentian include its ability to act as a diuretic, anti-spasmodic, and expectorant, making it useful in treating conditions like urinary tract issues, muscle spasms, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpenes, diterpenes, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
